step: 2 of 3: the registration, written BEFORE any P, D or Delta MSE of this population
what: the RNA test lane-scalefit registered as separate: on the genes M2h's fixed 0.2146 makes fittable, is the scaled run closer to measured RNA than the no-rule baseline
question: lane-scalefit showed, with no RNA opened, that 8,535 of the 12,500 genes 7d excluded as basal_not_positive become fittable when every single-removal drop is multiplied by M2h's fixed 0.2146. ON THOSE GENES, does the scaled run come closer to measured log2(TPM+1) across the thirteen reader cell types than the no-rule baseline? One form (the multiplicative composition, M2h's arm that read better), one scale (M2h's constant +0.2146, NOT refitted), one endpoint, read on the genes of this population that M2h held out of its own fit
population: THE GENES SCALING MAKES FITTABLE, re-derived here and not copied from any count. Starting from the 17,983 multi-element genes 7d/7e found eligible for a fit (`combine2`'s own eligibility, recomputed from the same 24 compiled non-coding programs), a gene is in this population when all four hold: (a) under the MEAN form, 7d's fit on the unscaled single-removal observations fails with the reason `basal_not_positive` (combine2.fit's `if not q < 1.0`), which is the 12,500; (b) under the MEAN form, 7d's SAME code on observations whose every single-removal effect is multiplied by scalefit.SCALE (`RHO_i -> 1 - SCALE * (1 - RHO_i)`) returns a positive basal rate, which is scalefit's PRIMARY `recovered`; (c) that scaled fit also passes 7d's FULL runnable test, i.e. every fitted strength lies in (0, 1], which is scalefit's SECONDARY `runnable_after`; (d) the gene has a row in 7h's committed multiplicative genes table (data/results/multrna_result.json, genes_table), which is what supplies this lane's P and D. (a) to (c) are predictor-side and are recomputed by scalefit's own functions; (d) is a lookup of 7h's population by SYMBOL ONLY and reads no value. The ENDPOINT is read on the HELD-OUT half of this population under magcal.is_held_out, so that no gene whose RNA entered M2h's fit of the scale is in the number that decides
population_harness: before any registration is written and before any RNA value is read: the re-derivation must reproduce all four of POPULATION_SOURCE_COUNTS' counts exactly, from the same compiled programs and the same code; the recovered genes must be a subset of the excluded genes and the runnable a subset of the recovered; every symbol must be non-empty and occur once. A miss in any of them is POPULATION_DEFECT and nothing else is computed
overlap_question: M2h read the multiplicative composition on 16,509 genes, 8,181 training and 8,328 held out, and its held-out reading of +0.04339 is over those 8,328. The brief that opened this lane stated that the recovered genes 'were in no previous reading'. THAT IS A CLAIM ABOUT POPULATIONS AND IT IS MEASURED HERE, NOT ASSUMED: the overlap of the re-derived recovered population with M2h's 16,509, with its 8,181 training genes and with its 8,328 held-out genes is counted and reported, and whichever way it comes out is what the registration's exposure sentence says. 7d's mean population (4,725 genes) is disjoint from the recovered population BY CONSTRUCTION -- a gene 7d excluded is not a gene 7d fitted -- but 7h's multiplicative population is NOT selected by the mean's basal rate and so may contain the recovered genes in full

carried_verbatim.endpoint: y(G, X) = log2(TPM(G, X) + PSEUDOCOUNT), TPM(G, X) the mean over the chosen experiment's files (RNA_SELECTION). The measured deviation is D(G, X) = y(G, X) - mean over the thirteen cells X' of y(G, X'): G's level in X relative to its own mean across the reader cells
carried_verbatim.no_rule_baseline: P(G, X) = 0: G's level in X equals its mean over the thirteen reader cells
carried_verbatim.rna_selection: per reader biosample, from the ENCODE portal: every released GRCh38 'gene quantifications' TSV with genome_annotation V29 (the ENCODE4 uniform RNA-seq pipeline, RSEM) of assay 'polyA plus RNA-seq', on the biosample's ontology term name, from a human experiment the portal lists as not perturbed (perturbed=false) and that carries no ERROR audit, and whose file biosample summary names no subcellular fraction, treatment, disease or genetic modification (none of 'fraction', 'treated', 'with ', 'genetically', 'transfected', 'knockdown'). polyA plus is the one assay with such an experiment for all thirteen (SK-N-SH has no whole-cell untreated total RNA-seq in this query). Of the qualifying experiments the one with the most qualifying files is taken, ties broken by the latest date_released and then the lowest accession; the gene's TPM in the biosample is the mean of its TPM over that experiment's qualifying files (its replicates). Chosen from portal metadata alone; no value of any file was read to choose
carried_verbatim.split: held out when int(sha256(symbol as UTF-8).hexdigest()[:8], 16) is odd, training when even (scripts/saturable_gate.is_held_out, the convention lane-saturable registered today, taken unchanged); the split is on the gene SYMBOL, so a gene falls the same side in every form, is fixed by this registration before any held-out number is read, and depends on no measured value. A gene is wholly on one side with all thirteen of its pairs: no cell of a held-out gene enters any fit
carried_verbatim.note: the endpoint, the baseline, the RNA selection, the pseudocount, the cells, the minimum size, the control, the bootstrap, the split and the form's words are 7d's, 7h's and M2h's, carried WORD FOR WORD. This lane defines no endpoint of its own and reads no cell, no experiment and no quantification those lanes did not. What is new here is ONLY the population: the genes 7d's mean form could not fit and the scaling makes fittable

predictions.form: per form F and gene G, P_F(G, X) for the thirteen cells X: the centred prediction of F's committed genes table, exactly as 7d's and 7h's PREDICTIONS['form'] define it (the gated run's log2 level in X minus its mean over the thirteen cells), rounded to five decimals by the committed table
predictions.calibrated: P^a(G, X) = SCALE * P(G, X) with SCALE the CONSTANT +0.2146, M2h's fitted scale for the multiplicative composition taken from data/results/magcal_result.json (scales.multiplicative, commit ac5580b) at full precision. NOTHING IS FITTED, REFITTED, RE-ESTIMATED, TUNED OR SELECTED IN THIS LANE. There is no per-gene parameter, no per-cell parameter, no intercept and no transformation of P: the whole calibration is one number that was fixed before this lane existed
predictions.no_rule_baseline: P(G, X) = 0: G's level in X equals its mean over the thirteen reader cells

scale_source: data/results/magcal_result.json, field scales.multiplicative, commit ac5580b (lane-magcal, M2h, ROADMAP §5 item 7j): the one scale per form fitted on 8,181 training genes and held out by int(sha256(symbol)[:8], 16) parity, reading +0.2146 [98.33% CI +0.2007, +0.2283] with a held-out Delta MSE of +0.04339 [98.33% CI +0.0379, +0.04894]. TAKEN FIXED, NOT REFITTED, NOT RE-ESTIMATED
no_refit: THE SCALE IS NOT REFITTED ON THIS POPULATION, AND THAT IS A CHOICE MADE HERE AND STATED, NOT AN OMISSION. The brief allowed either the fixed constant or a refit with its own held-out split, and not both. The fixed constant is taken, for three reasons. (1) The question is whether M2h's magnitude -- one number for the whole form, already fitted and already read -- also brings these genes closer to measured RNA; a scale refitted on them would answer a different question, namely whether SOME magnitude helps on them. (2) Refitting would spend the only genes of this population that M2h did not fit (its 4,009 held-out members) on a fit, leaving the endpoint either on fitted genes or on a second-order split of 2,000. (3) A fixed scale makes the number directly comparable with M2h's +0.04339 and M2i's +0.03727, which are the two numbers this reading has to be read against. The consequence is declared in advance: this lane CANNOT distinguish 'these genes need a different magnitude' from 'no magnitude helps on these genes', and a WORSE or INCONCLUSIVE reading here leaves that open (LIMITATIONS)
rows: per gene G of the population, the thirteen P and the thirteen D of G's row in 7h's committed multiplicative genes table (data/results/multrna_result.json, genes_table, pinned by sha256), taken unchanged and in the committed order. No P and no D is recomputed, recentred, reweighted or filtered here: they are the same rows 7h's registered reading and M2h's calibration were computed from, restricted to this population's symbols. A gene of the population with no row there is not in the population (POPULATION (d))
endpoint_side: the HELD-OUT half of the population under magcal.is_held_out, carried unchanged: the genes whose measured RNA did NOT enter M2h's fit of the scale. The training half is reported beside it as a descriptive and decides nothing, exactly as M2h reports its training Delta MSE beside its held-out one
metric: Delta MSE = mean over the pairs of D^2 - mean of (D - SCALE*P)^2 = mean of (2*SCALE*D*P - SCALE^2*P^2) (combine2.METRIC, magcal.METRIC and freshrna.METRIC with the fixed scale), positive when the scaled run's squared error is below the no-rule baseline's. THE REGISTERED ENDPOINT is this quantity on the HELD-OUT genes of the population at SCALE, with its INTERVAL_WORDS gene bootstrap interval. Reported beside it and deciding nothing: the same quantity at SCALE on the training half and on the whole population, and the same quantity at scale 1 (the uncalibrated form 7h read) on the held-out half
interval_reason: 98.33%, DECIDED NOW AND FOR A STATED REASON. It is M2h's width -- its Bonferroni adjustment of 95% over its three forms -- and M2i kept it for the same reason this lane does: ONE form and ONE endpoint are read here, so 95% is the width this lane's own multiplicity would license, and 98.33% is WIDER than that. Keeping it is therefore the conservative choice, and it is made so that this number, M2h's +0.04339 [98.33% CI +0.0379, +0.04894] and M2i's +0.03727 [+0.03202, +0.04299] are read at one width and can be put side by side without an interval conversion. No second interval is computed and no interval is chosen after a value is read

bootstrap.unit: gene: genes are resampled with replacement and carry all thirteen of their pairs
bootstrap.interval: the 98.33% percentile interval over GENE resamples with replacement, each gene carrying its thirteen pairs, with SCALE held fixed -- M2h's unit, resample count, seed and width (magcal.bootstrap_delta, called unchanged). No scale interval is bootstrapped here because no scale is fitted here; the scale interval the decision table needs is M2h's committed training interval, carried (SCALE_CI)

control: M2h's within-gene cell permutation, called through magcal.permuted_control unchanged (magcal.CONTROL): for each permutation, each gene's thirteen P values are permuted among its own thirteen cells by an independent draw of the seeded generator, every gene keeping its own prediction values, its own range and its own side of the split, and every pair keeping its own D; only the tie between a prediction and the cell it was made for is broken. PERMUTATIONS['count'] permutations at PERMUTATIONS['seed']; control p = (1 + permutations with held-out Delta MSE >= observed) / (1 + count). It is reported in every reading and changes no verdict
control_difference: ONE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE CONTROL AND THE ENDPOINT, STATED IN ADVANCE. magcal.permuted_control REFITS the scale on each permutation's training pairs, while the endpoint takes SCALE fixed. The function is used as it stands rather than reimplemented, so the control is allowed a fit the observed reading is not. That can only make the control HARDER to beat, never easier, so it is the conservative direction; it is named here because an unexplained asymmetry between a reading and its control is exactly the kind of thing that should not be discovered afterwards
harness: before any P, D or Delta MSE of this population is read: (1) data/results/recovered_population.json is present, its outcome is POPULATION_ESTABLISHED and its population_harness agrees; (2) its population_sha256 and held_out_sha256 recompute from its own symbol lists, so the population this run uses is byte-identical to the committed one; (3) 7h's genes table has its committed 16,509 genes and 214,617 pairs, every gene with thirteen P and thirteen D, and no symbol twice; (4) Delta MSE at scale 1 recomputed over ALL of 7h's pairs equals 7h's committed delta_mse within TOLERANCE, which is the check that these are the rows 7h's registered reading was computed on; (5) SCALE equals magcal_result.json's scales.multiplicative exactly and SCALE_CI its scale_cis.multiplicative exactly; (6) M2h's committed held-out gene count (8,328) and pair count (108,264) are reproduced from that table and magcal.is_held_out, which is the check that the split is M2h's; (7) every symbol of this population's held-out half satisfies magcal.is_held_out and none is in M2h's training set. A miss in any of them stops the run (HARNESS_DEFECT) and nothing is read
exposure: STATED PLAINLY, AS THE FIRST THING THIS REGISTRATION SAYS ABOUT ITS EVIDENCE, AND MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSERTED. The RNA is the same measurement read by item 7 (M2b), item 7d (M2c), item 7h (M2f), the capped-sum census (lane-capsumrna), M2h (lane-magcal) and -- for the fresh replication -- M2i (lane-freshrna): the same ENCODE polyA plus RNA-seq of the same thirteen reader biosamples, the same log2(TPM+1) endpoint, the same no-rule baseline, and literally the same committed P and D rows. THE BRIEF THAT OPENED THIS LANE SAID THESE GENES ENTERED NONE OF THOSE READINGS. THAT IS FALSE, AND data/results/recovered_population.json MEASURED IT BEFORE THIS REGISTRATION WAS WRITTEN: 7,999 of the 8,535 (93.72%) have a row in 7h's committed multiplicative table, so they were inside 7h's 16,509-gene reading and inside M2h's 16,509-gene calibration; 3,990 are in M2h's 8,181 TRAINING genes, so their measured RNA helped fit the constant +0.2146 this lane applies; and 4,009 are in M2h's 8,328 HELD-OUT genes, which is the population M2h's +0.04339 and M2i's +0.03727 were both read over. The reason is structural: 7h's multiplicative form is not selected by the mean form's basal rate, so a gene the mean form could not fit may still have been fitted and read under the multiplicative one. WHAT IS THEREFORE NEW HERE IS THE POPULATION AND NOT THE MEASUREMENT, AND NOT EVEN THE POPULATION'S MEMBERSHIP OF AN EARLIER READING: this is a SUBPOPULATION READING of M2h's held-out reading, on the 4,009 of its 8,328 genes that 7d's mean form could not fit and the scaling makes fittable. It is NOT a fresh test of the endpoint, it is NOT independent of M2h's reading, and no reading from it may be worded as one. The only genes of this population that no previous reading of this endpoint touched are the 536 with no row in 7h's table, and they are excluded here for want of a P and a D
exposure_clause: carried with every reading: the RNA is not a fresh measurement and this population is not a fresh population. It is the same ENCODE polyA plus RNA-seq of the same thirteen reader biosamples read by items 7, 7d, 7h, the capped-sum census, M2h and M2i, and the P and D are 7h's committed rows; 7,999 of the 8,535 recovered genes, including all 4,009 the endpoint is read on, were inside M2h's 16,509-gene calibration, and those 4,009 were inside the 8,328 M2h's +0.04339 and M2i's +0.03727 were read over. This is a SUBPOPULATION reading of M2h's held-out reading, not independent confirmation of it; what it adds is that the genes 7d could not fit at all are in it
which_scale_interval: THE SCALE INTERVAL THE TABLE'S STRADDLE BRANCH USES IS M2h's COMMITTED TRAINING INTERVAL, SCALE_CI = [+0.20074, +0.22830], because no scale is fitted in this lane and there is nothing here to bootstrap. IT EXCLUDES 0, SO THE 'calibration removes the rules' BRANCH IS UNREACHABLE HERE AND THAT IS DECLARED NOW, BEFORE ANY VALUE IS READ, not discovered afterwards. A straddling held-out interval therefore reads INCONCLUSIVE. The branch is kept in the table rather than deleted so that the table carried is the one the supervisor wrote, and so that the reason this lane cannot reach that branch is on the record: a dead-scale straddle is a thing a lane that FITS a scale can discover, and a lane that takes the scale as a constant cannot. M2i reached the same conclusion for the same reason (freshrna.DECISION: 'There is no fourth branch ... nothing is fitted here')
decision: 1. If the HARNESS misses, the run stops before any value of this population is read (HARNESS_DEFECT), and no Delta MSE is computed. 2. Fewer than MIN_GENES held-out genes in the population is NOT_TESTABLE and no comparison is read. 3. Otherwise the verdict is WHICH_GOVERNS' four-way table applied as written, through magcal.decide unchanged, on the HELD-OUT Delta MSE at SCALE with its 98.33% gene bootstrap interval and with SCALE_CI as the scale interval: lower bound > 0 -> BETTER; upper bound < 0 -> WORSE (the falsifier); a straddle -> INCONCLUSIVE, because SCALE_CI excludes 0 (WHICH_SCALE_INTERVAL). 4. The reading sentence is magcal.reading's for that outcome, the registered vocabulary 7d, 7h and M2h all use, with this lane's numbers in it and nothing else; it is composed by magcal.combined_reading, which appends M2h's own prior-exposure clause, and then POPULATION_CLAUSE, EXPOSURE_CLAUSE and VARIANCE_CLAUSE are appended in that order and always. 5. The control p is reported in every verdict sentence and changes no verdict. 6. A WORSE or an INCONCLUSIVE reading IS REPORTED FIRST AND UNSOFTENED. It would mean the scaling recovers genes the FIT can accept but not genes the MODEL predicts, which is a sharper finding than a confirmation and the more useful one for what to build next
variance_clause: about {pct}% of the variance of measured log2(TPM+1) on these genes (Delta MSE divided by the held-out mean(D^2) = {d2}), carried beside the reading as M2h's and M2i's readings carry theirs (M2h 2.0%, M2i 2.3%)
population_clause: the population is the {n} genes of the {total} that 7d's mean form excluded as basal_not_positive and M2h's fixed 0.2146 makes fittable, restricted to those M2h held out of its own fit; a gene is in it because the FIT can accept it at that scale, which lane-scalefit established and which says nothing by itself about expression
falsifier: the reading under test is that the genes scaling makes FITTABLE are also genes the scaled run PREDICTS: that on the 4,009 held-out recovered genes the multiplicative composition at the fixed +0.2146 is closer to measured log2(TPM+1) than running no rule, as M2h found on all 8,328 of its held-out genes. It is FALSIFIED when the held-out Delta MSE interval EXCLUDES 0 ON THE BASELINE'S SIDE (upper bound < 0, outcome WORSE): the scaling then recovers genes the fit can accept but not genes the model predicts, M2h's gain does not reach into the population 7d could not fit, and the recovery is an arithmetic property of the drops and not a gain in prediction. A straddle (INCONCLUSIVE) falsifies nothing and confirms nothing and is reported as a failure to show the gain on this population, not as 'no difference'. An interval excluding 0 on the rules' side (BETTER) is the registered positive, in EXPOSURE's narrow terms and with VARIANCE_CLAUSE attached
stop_rule: ONE run, from this registration's committed code, on the files it pins by sha256. No form, scale, population, split, endpoint, metric, interval, control, decision, falsifier or wording is changed after a value of this population is read; a defect found afterwards is reported beside the registered reading and corrected only under a new registration. There is no post-hoc block in this registration: anything computed after the reading is committed is labelled post hoc, decides nothing, and is not required
limitations: PRIOR EXPOSURE, FIRST AND LARGEST: see EXPOSURE. This is a subpopulation reading of M2h's held-out reading on the same committed P and D rows, not a fresh test. 4,009 of the 4,009 genes the endpoint is read on were inside the 8,328 M2h's +0.04339 and M2i's +0.03727 were read over. No number here is a blind prediction

THE SCALE IS NOT REFITTED (NO_REFIT), so this lane cannot tell 'these genes need a different magnitude' from 'no magnitude helps on these genes'. A WORSE or INCONCLUSIVE reading here leaves that question open and naming it would need a second registration with its own split

THE TWO FORMS DIFFER. The population is defined by the MEAN form's exclusion and the recovery is computed at M2h's MULTIPLICATIVE scale applied to the mean's drops, which lane-scalefit already recorded as a TRANSFER ACROSS FORMS that M2h does not license (scalefit.LIMITATIONS[0]: M2h's own mean scale read +0.05032). The prediction read against RNA here is the MULTIPLICATIVE one. So 'the genes scaling makes fittable' is a mean-form statement and 'the scaled run' is a multiplicative-form prediction, and a reading here does not say that the mean form's scaled fit predicts anything

RECOVERY IS NOT A PROPERTY OF THE PREDICTION READ. A gene is in this population because the mean form's basal rate is positive again at 0.2146. Its multiplicative P was computed by 7h without reference to that, so this lane is asking whether a population selected on one form's fittability behaves differently under another form's prediction, and a difference from M2h's 8,328 could come from anything that distinguishes these genes -- their rule counts (median 15 for the recovered against 58 for the 3,708 that stay unfittable), their expression range, their loci -- and not from the recovery as such

536 of the 8,535 recovered-and-runnable genes have no row in 7h's table and are excluded for want of a P and a D. They are the only genes of this population no previous reading of this endpoint touched, so the one part of it that would have been a fresh population is exactly the part that cannot be read
the P and D are 7h's committed tables' five-decimal roundings, which is why the harness admits TOLERANCE rather than exact equality

the gene-level bootstrap treats genes as independent. Genes that share compiled elements or a locus are not, so the interval may be too narrow; M2i's post-hoc 1-Mb locus-cluster bootstrap moved its interval very little ([+0.03216, +0.04302] against [+0.03202, +0.04299]) but that is M2i's population and not this one
the control refits where the endpoint does not (CONTROL_DIFFERENCE), in the conservative direction
descriptives: deciding nothing: the held-out Delta MSE at scale 1 (the uncalibrated form 7h read) with its interval; the Delta MSE at SCALE on the training half and on the whole population; the gene and pair counts of each side; mean(D^2), mean(P^2), mean(SCALE^2 P^2) and mean(D*P) on each side; the held-out Delta MSE per reader cell; and M2h's and M2i's committed readings quoted verbatim beside this one, because the only honest way to read a subpopulation number is against the population's number

sentences: the recovered population OVERLAPS M2h's multiplicative population: 7999 of its 8535 genes are among those 16509 (93.72%), and 536 are not
the recovered population OVERLAPS M2h's training genes: 3990 of its 8535 genes are among those 8181 (46.75%), and 4545 are not
the recovered population OVERLAPS M2h's held-out genes: 4009 of its 8535 genes are among those 8328 (46.97%), and 4526 are not

context_verbatim.m2h_multiplicative_reading: the multiplicative composition (Zhou et al. 2024): better; on genes held out of the fit, the reader-gated run scaled by the one factor fitted on the training genes lowered the squared error of measured log2(TPM+1) across the thirteen reader cell types below the no-rule baseline's, so it is closer to measured RNA than the no-rule baseline (held-out Delta MSE +0.04339 [98.33% CI +0.0379, +0.04894] over 108,264 gene-cell pairs, 8,328 genes; control p = 0.000999; fitted scale +0.2146 [98.33% CI +0.2007, +0.2283], one number for the whole form, fitted on 8,181 training genes (106,353 gene-cell pairs) and applied unchanged to the held-out genes; the uncalibrated size 7d and 7h read is 1)
context_verbatim.m2h_variance_share: about 2.0% of the held-out mean(D^2) of 2.1524
context_verbatim.m2i_verdict_sentence: the multiplicative composition (Zhou et al. 2024): better; on a measurement of the same thirteen reader cell types that this project had never read, the reader-gated run scaled by M2h's fitted constant +0.2146 lowered the squared error of measured log2(TPM+1) across those cell types below the no-rule baseline's, so it is closer to measured RNA than the no-rule baseline on this measurement, and M2h's gain REPLICATES ON A FRESH MEASUREMENT OF THE SAME CELLS (Delta MSE +0.03727 [98.33% CI +0.03202, +0.04299] over 108,264 gene-cell pairs, 8,328 genes; control p = 0.000999; the scale is the constant +0.2146 taken from ac5580b and NOTHING IS FITTED IN THIS LANE)
context_verbatim.scalefit_verdict: the magnitude error partly explains the exclusions: scaling every single-removal drop by M2h's fixed 0.2146 gives 8792 of the 12500 genes 7d excluded as basal_not_positive a positive basal rate again, clearing the floor of 6251 but not the strong bar of 10000; the remaining 3708 need another cause. A recovered gene is a gene the fit can now accept and nothing more: this says nothing about expression
context_verbatim.note: quoted, not re-decided; summaries keep a lane's registered wording word for word

rna_read: none: this step registers and reads no P, no D and no Delta MSE
money: none: no request is sent and no key is read

data/results/magcal_result.json (M2h, the scale and the split)

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record 58dbba0

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
